items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We had like Bobby Stark. We know he drank a lot and Bobby would listen to us.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

That's what made those bands in those days great, because everybody worked together. They didn't have, like, hire a man, you're just here, just playing your horn. You was like, become a part of the band. And you'd have to be that type to live with this, because you couldn't be an outsider. Everybody would be together. And so, that's why we got -- a lot of things we'd call rehearsal. And these rehearsals was to iron out the mistakes going on in the band. We didn't care whose feelings it hurt, because if we hurt…
